toast.configRequiredDesc: Please complete the API and sender address configuration.
toast.insufficientBalanceDesc: Wallet balance ({balance}€) is too low for this product ({cost}€).

toast.purchaseFailedDesc: Failed to purchase label from Deutsche Post.
toast.labelRetrievedDesc: Order {order} was bought — label saved to history.

history.refundConfirm: Stamp {id} becomes invalid; the amount goes back to Portokasse.

settings.live: Live: buy and print labels from Cardmarket emails
settings.dryRunHint: Dry run: orders are checked and posted to Discord, nothing is bought.
settings.liveHint: LIVE: every new ship-order email buys a label and charges Portokasse. Stop buying Cardmarket labels by hand.

settings.printWindowHint: HH:MM-HH:MM, Berlin time. Outside it orders wait. 00:00-24:00 = always.
settings.intakeHint: Empty field = value from .env (in grey). Takes effect at the next mail poll; every change is posted to Discord.

intake.nothingToPay: No Paket orders waiting for payment.
intake.cartHint: Paid but no label after a few minutes? Enter the cart number (Warenkorb-Nr.) from DHL's confirmation page.
intake.noOrders: No orders in the last 14 days.
